title: Scout G-S2 (worker packet and tool-output surfaces): what a worker receives at start, what it fetches in its first turns, where outputs are capped, and what a compact packet generator can build from
spec:
Goal T-0260 wants workers to start from a compact packet (objective, acceptance, base commit, write scope and read scope, relevant symbols and tests, interface decisions, applicable gotchas with references, verification commands, evidence pointers) and wants every tool output that reaches a model bounded with an expansion path. Inventory with path:line:
1. Prompts: .orchestrator/prompts/execute.md, fix-delta.md, review.md, spec-review.md, scout.md, planner-decision.md and spawn.render (orchestrator/spawn.py): which variables are filled, how large a rendered execute prompt is for a typical spec (measure one: render the T-0256 spec through spawn.render or estimate from the template), and what the worker is told to do first (recall, bus_read, tests).
2. First-turn behaviour: from .orchestrator/runs/jev/gate.jsonl rows for T-0244, T-0246, T-0242 (fields tool, input path or command), list what workers read or ran in their first 10 tool calls; note repeated reads of the same path.
3. Caps that exist today: spawn.fit_result and MAX_RESULT_CHARS in bus_mcp/bus, bus_read compact rows, tests-green.sh output shape (what a worker sees on pass and on fail, lines), recall.py output size, handover pruning. Where is there no cap (raw git diff, grep, test logs)?
4. Packet inputs available without a model: task scope and acceptance, git merge-base and branch, tests/test_<module>.py by scope module name, gotchas.md entries mentioning a scope path (grep), memory/architecture.md (empty today), symbols per scope file (python ast), verification command (tests-green.sh .). Say which are cheap to generate in spawn.py at dispatch time.
Report: inventory table, measured sizes (prompt chars, tests-green lines, gate rows per worker), a packet template of at most 40 lines, and the three highest-value output bounds. Under 1,500 tokens, confidence per finding.
acceptance: rendered execute prompt size measured or estimated with the method stated
first-turn tool calls listed for at least two workers from gate.jsonl
packet template of at most 40 lines and three output bounds proposed
result under 1,500 tokens with a confidence per finding

findings.claim: execute.md fills {{spec}},{{acceptance}},{{scope}}; tells worker to implement then run scripts/tests_green.sh — no recall/bus_read step in the template itself
planner-decision.md does not exist; prompts dir has execute,fix-delta,review,spec-review,scout,challenge.md only
fix-delta.md fills {{n}},{{failing_tests}},{{assertion_lines}}; tells worker to fix within scope and rerun tests_green.sh
review.md fills {{complexity}},{{security}},{{diff}},{{acceptance}}; diff is inserted raw with no size guard at the render call
spec-review.md fills {{complexity}},{{spec}},{{acceptance}},{{scope}},{{code}} (numbered excerpts)
scout.md fills {{id}},{{title}},{{turns}},{{spec}},{{acceptance}}; turn budget lives in the template, recall/bus_read instructions come from the task spec text, not the template
spawn.render does plain {{key}} string substitution, json.dumps(indent=0) for non-str kwargs, no length check
Rendered execute prompt for T-0256's actual spec measured 3011 chars (~752 tokens @4 chars/tok) vs 270-char raw template — spec(2263)+acceptance(439)+scope(70) dominate
gate.jsonl rows carry only ts/task/session/tool/p_needed/p_redundant/p_destructive/mode/blocked/latency_ms/scored — no input path or command field exists, contrary to the assumed schema
T-0244 first-turn tools (9 rows total): Grep,Read,Read,Read,Read,Read,Bash,Bash,Bash
T-0246 first 10: Read,Read,Bash,Read,Bash,Bash,Bash,Bash,Bash,Read (11 rows total) — heavy Bash repetition mid-sequence

T-0242 has only 4 gate rows, all Read — cannot show repeated-path evidence since path isn't logged, but p_redundant 0.9-0.93 recurs on several Read/Bash calls in T-0244/246, implying redundancy the gate detects without needing the path field
fit_result truncates summary to 1500 chars then binary-searches each list key down to fit under MAX_RESULT_CHARS=6000 (~1500 tok), largest list first
bus.post_result raises ValueError over 6000 chars instead of shrinking — fit_result must be called by the caller first, it's not automatic
bus_read returns full task dicts with no compact projection or size cap — this is an existing gap

open_questions: Does anything truncate {{diff}} before review.md render, or does a large diff just inflate the reviewer prompt uncapped?
Where does handover pruning actually live (file not found in this worktree)?
suggested_next: Bound 1: cap {{diff}} and {{code}} in review.md/spec-review.md through fit_result-style truncation (e.g. 4000 chars + '...N more lines, run git diff <path> to expand') before render() — currently unguarded per spawn.py:70-141
Bound 2: give bus_read an optional compact=True mode returning {id,status,role,summary[:500]} rows instead of full dicts, since bus_mcp.py:29-31 has no size limit today

Bound 3: cap scout Bash/Grep tool output at dispatch via allowedTools wrapper or a PreToolUse truncator (mirroring tests-green.sh's 40-line pattern), since raw git diff/grep/test-log output has no cap at the tool layer
